build_model_instance: build a Model instance with an encoder, config, tokenizer, and args for NL-code retrieval
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on code and natural language inputs to compute contrastive loss
extract_code_nl_vectors: extract code and natural language embedding vectors by calling forward with return_vec=True
review_model_forward: review the Model forward method that computes similarity scores and cross-entropy loss for code-NL pairs
test_model_contrastive_loss: test the Model class to verify contrastive loss computation between code and NL embeddings
